title: Admin
loadFailedBody: Check the connection, then try again.
reasonPlaceholder: For example: off the menu for the season

form.priceInvalid: Enter an amount like 450 or 450.50 (no currency sign).
form.prepTimeInvalid: Enter whole minutes from 0 to 240, or leave it empty.
form.tableNumberInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 999.
form.capacityInvalid: Enter a whole number of seats from 1 to 50.
form.sectionRequired: Enter a section, for example Hall.
form.usernameInvalid: Use 3 to 32 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores, no spaces.
form.phoneTooLong: Keep the phone number to 30 characters.
form.currencyInvalid: Use a 3-letter currency code and 0 to 3 decimals.
form.rateInvalid: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100 with at most 2 decimals.
form.roundingInvalid: Enter a rounding step of at least the smallest coin.
form.kitchenLateAfterWarn: Late must be more minutes than Waiting.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noSales: No completed sales on this day yet.
dashboard.note: Sales are completed (served and paid) orders. Open bills are orders of this day that are not finished yet.

menu.title: Menu
menu.description: Items, prices and photos. A price change applies to new orders only.
menu.orderHint: To change the order of items, choose one category.
menu.restored: The item is back on the menu.
menu.archiveBody: It leaves every ordering screen at once. Old orders and reports keep it. You can restore it later.

item.name: Name
item.pricesBody: Amounts in the restaurant's currency. Tax and service charge are added by the system from Settings.
item.costHint: Only admins see this. It is used for profit reports.
item.priceNewOrdersOnly: The new price applies to new orders only. Open and old orders keep their price.
item.needsKitchenHint: Switch off for items that need no cooking, like bottled drinks: they never appear on the kitchen screen.
item.availableHint: Switch off to mark it sold out on every screen.
item.photoBody: A JPEG, PNG or WebP. It is resized and saved as WebP before the upload.

photoError.notImage: That file is not a picture. Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
photoError.tooLarge: That photo is too large (over 20 MB). Choose a smaller one.
photoError.unreadable: That photo could not be read. Try another one.
photoError.noWebp: This browser can't prepare photos. Use Chrome or Edge to add photos.
photoError.stillTooLarge: That photo is still too large after resizing. Try a simpler photo.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: The groups on the menu, in the order the staff see them.
categories.nameBody: A short name the staff will see, for example Starters.
categories.name: Name
categories.empty: No categories yet. Add the first one.
categories.archiveHasItems: Move or archive its items first.
categories.archiveHint: A category can be archived when it has no active items left.
categories.archiveBody: It leaves the menu. You can restore it later.

tables.title: Tables
tables.description: Every table with its live status. Numbers must be unique.
tables.formBody: The waiters see tables by section and number.
tables.sectionHint: For example Hall or Family. Choose one in use or type a new one.
tables.empty: No tables yet. Add the first one.
tables.archiveBody: It leaves the waiters' and cashier's screens. A table with an open bill can't be archived.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: The restaurant's details and rules. The app uses only these values.
settings.restaurantBody: Shown in the header and on every receipt.
settings.name: Restaurant name
settings.taxNumberHint: Printed on the receipt when filled in.
settings.footerHint: A line at the bottom of every receipt, for example Thank you.
settings.moneyBody: Rates are percentages of the bill.
settings.currencyHint: The currency can't change once orders exist, because old bills would show the wrong amounts.
settings.rulesBody: How the system works out every bill. Check a real bill with Bill check after a change.

rule.discount_reduces_charges: Discount comes off before tax and service charge

ruleHint.prices_include_tax: On: the tax is already inside the menu prices and is only shown. Off: tax is added on top.
ruleHint.discount_reduces_charges: On: tax and service charge are worked out on the bill after the discount.
ruleHint.service_charge_on_dine_in: Adds the service charge to Dine-In bills.
ruleHint.service_charge_on_take_away: Adds the service charge to Take Away bills.
ruleHint.service_charge_on_delivery: Adds the service charge to Delivery bills (from Phase 3).
ruleHint.tax_on_service_charge: On: tax is also charged on the service charge.

settings.roundingUnitHint: The step tax and service charge are rounded to, for example 1 or 0.01.
settings.dayBody: Orders after midnight and before the cut-off belong to the previous day.
settings.kitchenBody: How long a ticket can wait before the kitchen screen shows it amber, then red.
settings.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved.

billCheck.title: Bill check
billCheck.description: Type the lines of a real bill to see what this system charges with the current settings. Nothing is saved.
billCheck.linesHint: Each line is quantity times price, for example 1200 for 2 x 600.
billCheck.linesInvalid: Each line must be an amount above zero, like 450 or 450.50.
billCheck.empty: Enter the lines and check the bill.
billCheck.basis: Worked out by the server with today's settings, the same way as every order.

staff.title: Staff
staff.description: Everyone who signs in. Staff can't sign up themselves.
staff.newBody: A temporary password is shown once after saving. Give it to the person; they sign in with the username.
staff.editBody: A role change signs the person out, so they see their new screens.
staff.usernameHint: 3 to 32 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores. It can't change later.
staff.roleHint: Admins have full access and must use two-step sign-in.
staff.passwordBody: Write it down or copy it now: it is shown only once. The person signs in with the username and this password.
staff.resetPasswordBody: They are signed out everywhere and get a new temporary password.
staff.resetMfaBody: For a lost phone. They are signed out and set up a new authenticator at the next sign-in.
staff.mfaReset: {{name}} sets up two-step sign-in again at the next sign-in.
staff.deactivateBody: They are signed out at once and can't sign in again. Their orders stay in the reports. You can reactivate them later.
